data.one_liner: Provides a node.js preamble for dart2js output to improve compatibility with Node, Webpack and Electron.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies a JavaScript preamble that replaces the default d8.js preamble used by dart2js. It fixes timer, event‑loop and environment detection issues for Node.js, Webpack, and Electron runtimes.
use_when: Running dart2js‑compiled code in a Node.js environment
Needing better Electron or Webpack compatibility than the default preamble provides
avoid_when: Targeting pure browsers where the default preamble works
When you don’t need custom environment detection
strengths: Fixes crashes in browser and Electron environments
Keeps Uri.base and location.href in sync with the working directory
weaknesses: Only provides a preamble, no other runtime utilities
Limited to the specific use‑case of dart2js output
May become outdated if Node or Dart internals change
data.setup_notes: Add the package, import preamble.dart, and call preamble.getPreamble() where needed.
